(2) parseArgs: when the command word is "clear" (in the same argv position the existing commands use), return { kind: "clear" }. Do not change how existing commands are parsed. (3) run(path, { kind: "clear" }): load the todos from path with storage.load, apply clear, save the result with storage.save, and return the text `Cleared N todo(s)`, where N is the number of todos removed. The types unit is adding { kind: "clear" } to the Command union this round, so handle that variant everywhere Command is switched on. Add unit tests in src/commands.test.ts.
